title: Formulary Benefit External Review Priority: Placing the Ready Day on the Dispensing Pharmacy Calendar
content:
## Calendar rule

When a member asks for an independent external review of a denied exception under the Formulary Benefit, the ready day is the day by which the drug could reach the member. It is reckoned on the calendar of the pharmacy that dispensed the member's latest shipped specialty fill of the drug, as recorded in the Specialty Pharmacy Program.

**Total wait and ready day.** Every wait counted for the review is a number of calendar days from the handling date, as the independent reviewer's, the review package's and the appeal program's hours define them. Their sum is the total wait. The ready day falls that many whole days after the handling date.

**Dispensed by Northbridge Specialty Pharmacy** (ships Monday through Friday only):
- a ready day falling on a Saturday or a Sunday is moved to the following Monday;
- the Specialty Pharmacy Program's delivery scheduling lead for the drug, which is counted in business days, is then counted forward from that day over Mondays through Fridays only. Each weekend crossed adds its Saturday and Sunday to the count of days.

**Dispensed by a retail pharmacy:** a ready day falling on a Sunday is moved to the following Monday, and the retail pickup wait of **1** day is added.

**Otherwise:** the ready day is taken as it falls.

**Days to the ready day.** The days counted from the handling date to the ready day are the total wait, together with:
- any days by which the ready day was moved;
- for Northbridge Specialty Pharmacy, the business-day lead counted as described;
- for a retail pharmacy, the 1-day pickup wait.

The review is expedited when the days of the drug left (after any reserve) are fewer than these days.

## Worked cases (hypothetical; total wait 3 days; scheduling lead 2 business days)

| Handling date | Ready day as it falls | Northbridge Specialty Pharmacy | Retail pharmacy |
|---|---|---|---|
| Monday | Thursday | lead counted Friday and Monday, so 7 days | Thursday, 3 days and 1 day pickup, so 4 days |
| Wednesday | Saturday | moved to Monday (2 days), then lead counted Tuesday and Wednesday, so 7 days | Saturday stays, 3 days and 1 day pickup, so 4 days |
| Thursday | Sunday | moved to Monday (1 day), then lead counted Tuesday and Wednesday, so 6 days | moved to Monday (1 day) and 1 day pickup, so 5 days |
